headline: Nigeria Sets November 30 Tax Registration Deadline for Crypto Exchanges
summary: Nigeria's tax authority has ordered cryptocurrency exchanges and virtual asset service providers to register on its new VASP Tax Portal by November 30 and integrate systems by December 31 under threat of penalties.
why: Nigeria is one of the world's largest peer-to-peer cryptocurrency markets; taxation brings digital asset platforms under regulatory oversight.

impacts.name: Nigerian Crypto Exchanges
impacts.why: Mandatory tax registration and IT compliance by December 31 increases operational overhead and penalties.
